buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 2. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 3. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Contact details: 1. Dipthi Nikose, DGM Purchase, 9450925449, dipthinikose@ntpc.co.in 2. Sudipto De Sarkar, AGM Purchase, 9650509419, sudiptodesarkar@ntpc.co.in Buyer Added Bid Specific Terms and Conditions

1 Open Tender without Qualifying requirements. 2 Nil deviation clause for all schedules: Compliance to ALL provisions of the bidding document (Nil Deviation bid) is mandatory whic h is to be accepted through the “Seller undertaking” during submission of offer by the seller in GeM. Through their acceptance, the seller undertakes the following: “1. With reference to our bid submitted against the tender, we hereby confirm that we com ply with all terms, conditions and specifications of the Bidding Documents read in conjunctio n with Amendment(s) / Clarification(s) / Addenda/Errata (if any) issued by the Employer prio r to opening of Techno-Commercial Bids and the same has been taken into consideration wh ile making our Techno-Commercial Bid & Price Bid and we declare that we have not taken a ny deviation in this regard. 2. We understand that in case the Products and/or Services offered do not meet the technic al requirements, then our bid shall be rejected as Technically non-responsive. We also confirm that in case we refuse to withdraw additional conditions/deviation s/variatio ns/exception, implicit or explicit, found anywhere in the techno-commercial bid, our bid shal l be rejected as Technically non-responsive. We further confirm that if any deviation/variation in any form is found in our Price Bid, the E MD shall be forfeited”. 3 If any seller/bidder has any clarification against technical specification or otherwise on any aspect of this bid, they can raise their representation against the same by using the Repres entation Window provided in the bid details field in Seller dashboard after logging in as a se ller within the time period after bid publication as allowed by GeM. Clarification asked throu gh any means other than above, may not be considered by NTPC.

4 Bidder may quote as per "Technical Specification" and/ or spec sheet attached for each line item/ schedule. In case of any contradiction between Category/ BOQ Item description and "T echnical Specification" of the item(s) attached in the tender, TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION OF THAT ITEM SHOULD BE CONSIDERED FOR THE SUBMISSION OF OFFER AND SAME SHALL BE CONSIDERED FOR EVALUATION PURPOSE AT OUR END. The details mentioned in the detaile d Technical specification shall be considered final for the offer/ bid/ technical evaluation. Bidder has to quote make and model in GeM as per option available in GeM during submissi on of offer after meeting all the technical specification of tender. After opening of bids, any c hange in vendor's quoted make or model in their bid cannot be done and any such request will be rejected. In the event of an order, vendor’s quoted make and model in their bid will also get automatically populated in the GEM Purchase order. Also, MSE & MII benefits will b e given exclusively based on documents submitted in reference to the "quoted make and m odel" submitted in the GeM bid. 5 Guarantee/Warranty: 12 months from the date of use/commissioning or 18 months from the date of supply, whichever is earlier. (The Guarantee/ Warranty Terms and Conditions shall b e applicable to the material supplied against the PO. No separate Guarantee/ Warranty Certi ficate is required to be submitted by the Supplier along with the material. The Guarantee / Warranty terms and condition shall be binding on the supplier). If any higher Guarantee/war ranty mentioned in the technical specification the same shall be applicable. 6 Common IP Addresses: - Bidders may please note that GeM is capturing and presenting to t he buyer the IP addresses used by the Buyer and the Bidder(s) /Seller(s). The received bids having matching/common IP address with either Bidder(s)/Seller(s) or Buyer, shall be outrightly rejected & shall not be considered for further evaluation. 7 During techno-commercial evaluation of offer, clarification/ reply to the queries (if asked by NTPC) given by bidder will be considered an integral part of the GeM purchase order and th e vendor will be liable to execute the PO also in accordance with the same. Furthermore, in the event subsequent clarification(s)/query(ies) are sought and bidder fails to respond or re sponds with incorrect / inadequate or non-compliant information, the bid will be liable to be rejected. Subsequent representation(s) may not be accepted in such cases. 8 All post award communication/ grievance will be addressed to consignee at email id: storei ncharge-kanti@ntpc.co.in. In case of non-resolution of the issue, matter can be escalated al ong with previous correspondence(s) to email id:- vendor_grievance_cpg2@ntpc.co.in. 9 Payment terms: As per tech. specs. If submission of PBG is a requirement of the tender, no payment shall be processed without submission of PBG. 10 Make in India (MII): Definitions, Explanatory Notes, Application of Purchase Preference in various scenarios & Fo rmats with regards to Local Content are available in Annexue-8 of the ATC attachment uplo aded along with the tender. Declaration of Local Content is a self-certification which is submitted by a bidder clearly indi cating the following details (Annexure-8): · Description of Goods and Services offered. · Whether meeting Class-I/Class-II/Non-Local Supplier as per tender terms and conditio ns. · % of Local Value Addition. · Location at which local value addition is made.

Complaints pertaining to Local content declaration/value addition, if any, may be addressed by the complainant to the committee constituted by MoP, for independent verification of sel f-declarations and auditor's / accountant's certificates on random basis and in the case of c omplaints. The composition of the committee is as specified in MoP Order ref. no. A-1/2021- FSC-Part(5) dated 16.11.2021. In case of complaint made by any bidder to the Standing Committee constituted by MoP, th e tendering process will continue unless there is specific instruction/communication from th e Standing Committee/MoP/CEA to put the tendering process on hold. Annexure 8: Declaration regarding Local Content as per the Employer’s format, for granting of purchase preference/ acceptance as Class-I/ II Local Supplier: In case a bidder does not submit the aforesaid declaration or statement/ any declaration like ‘later’, ‘to be furnished later’, ‘NA’ etc. are indicated by the bidder, then the Bidder is lia ble not to be considered as a local supplier and may not be eligible for any purchase preference/ bid is liable to be considered non-responsive and may be rejected. Further, Bidder shall be required to submit a certificate from the statutory auditor or cost a uditor (in the case the bidder is a company) or from a practicing cost accountant or practicin g chartered accountant (in respect of bidders other than companies) giving the percentage of local content at the time of execution of the project, or where it is not possibl e to provide certification at the time of execution of project, during execution prior to submi ssion of last bill for payment.# In case aforesaid Certificate furnished by Contractor/Vendor is not in line with the declaration in respect of Local content in their bid, same may be treat ed as false declaration and may be dealt in line with the Fraud Prevention Policy of NTPC. Bidders (in case manufacturers) are required to submit any of the following documents viz. Latest Annual Report or NSIC / SSI / BIS License/ ISO Certificate / Any Other Statutory Docu ment as a proof of manufacturer of the offered product. In case bidder is a dealer/ trader, th ey are required to submit Declaration of Local Content duly signed by manufacturer along with submission of proof of manufacturing as elaborated above. For tenders having lumpsum/ package evaluation involving supply of multiple items, weight ed average of all items to be taken while calculating the local content of the package. In case of Procurement of Instruments such as Testing Instrument/ Measuring Instrument / A nalysers etc. or if required by the buyer, bidder may be asked to furnish following supportin g documents for Proof of Manufacturing of the specified Item(s) and/or Place of Local Value Addition: I. Latest Annual Report; or II. NSIC/ DIC/SSI Certificate; or III. BIS License/ ISO Certificate; or IV. Factory License/ Consent to Operate; or V. NABL Accreditation Certificate of Manufacturer’s Laboratory; or VI. Vendor Assessment Report issued by GeM Authority; or VII. Any Other Statutory/Relevant Document as proof of manufacturing/Local value Addition.

11 CONFLICT OF INTEREST: A bidder shall not have conflict of interest with other bidders. Such conflict of interest can le ad to anti- competitive practices to the detriment of Employer’s interests. A bidder may be considered to have a conflict of interest with one or more parties in this bidding process, if: a) they directly or indirectly control, or are controlled by or are under common control of an other entity; or b) they have the same legal representative/agent for purposes of their bids; or c) they have relationship with each other, directly or through common third party(ies), that puts them in a position to have access to information about or influence on the bid of anoth er Bidder; or d) Bidder and/or any of its allied entity(ies), which directly or indirectly control(s) or is(are) c ontrolled by or is(are) under common control of another entity, has(ve) participated as a co nsultant in the preparation of the design or technical specifications of the contract that is th e subject of the tender; or e) Bidder participates in more than one bid in this bidding process. f) In cases of agents quoting on behalf of their principal manufacturers/service providers, o ne agent cannot represent two manufacturers/service providers or quote on their behalf in a particular tender enquiry. One manufacturer/service provider can also authorize only one agent. There can be only one bid from the following: i) The principal manufacturer/service provider directly or through one Indian agent on his b ehalf; and ii) Indian/foreign agent on behalf of only one principal. For the purposes of this clause the term ‘control’ shall have the following meaning: “Control” shall include the right to appoint majority of the directors or to control the manag ement or policy decisions exercisable by a person or persons acting individually or in concer t, directly or indirectly, including by virtue of their shareholding or management rights or sh areholders’ agreements or voting agreements or in any other manner. Vendor has to submit CONFLICT OF INTEREST declaration in bid during submission offer as d etail as “We confirm that we have read and understood the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Cl ause regarding “Conflict of Interest” and our bid is in compliance to this clause. In case it is established that we have provided any false information in pursuance of the aforesaid Clause, while competing for this contract, then our bid shall be rejected and bid security sh all be forfeited. We also understand that in case we become successful bidder, if it is establi shed that we have not complied with terms of aforesaid Clause, during execution of contrac t, this would be considered as fraudulent practice as mentioned in para 5.1 (j) of “Policy for Debarment from Business Dealings” and shall be dealt accordingly.” Note: Policy for Debarment from Business Dealings available at "https://ntpc.co.in/sites/def ault/files/policy- documents/Policy_for_Debarment_from_Business_Dealings.pdf". CONFLICT OF INTEREST DECLARATION FORM ……………………………………. PACKAGE FOR ……………………………………………………………… …. PROJECT BIDDING DOCUMENT NO. …………………………………….. (Compliance to “Conflic t of Interest” provisions) We confirm that we have read and understood the ITB* Clause regarding “Conflict of Interes t” and our bid is in compliance to this clause.

In case it is established that we have provided any false information in pursuance of the afo resaid ITB* Clause, while competing for this contract, then our bid shall be rejected and bid security shall be forfeited. We also understand that in case we become successful bidder, if it is established that we ha ve not complied with terms of aforesaid ITB Clause, during execution of contract, this would be considered as fraudulent practice as mentioned in para 5.1 (j) of “Policy for Debarment fr om Business Dealings” and shall be dealt accordingly. 12 Risk purchase- In the event of Suppliers failure to supply the material of acceptable quality i n scheduled delivery period, NTPC reserves the right to procure the materials from any othe r source at the Suppliers risk and cost and the difference in cost shall be borne by the Suppl ier. Further, NTPC shall retain the right of forfeiture of CPG/ PBG and or any other action as deemed fit. 13 Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI): Not Applicable. 14 EMD Not applicable. 15 Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) Detail Not APPLICABLE 16 MSME benefit (purchase preference) is to be given as per following conditions: In case of procurement of goods/ services, preferences to MSEs whose quoted prices are wit hin L1 (non-MSEs) +15% range (subject to matching of L1 price) will be given in the followin g order: a) SC-ST Women MSEs b) SC-ST other than Women MSEs c) Women MSEs d) Other MSEs The MSE order quantity will be as per following: i. Where the requirement is Not-Splitable: 100% of contract quantity will be awarded to MSE s. ii. Where the requirement is Splitable: 25% of contract quantity will be awarded to MSEs. In case of more than one MSEs (for the same category) are within range of L1+15 % price, the n 25% of tendered quantity will be divided equally amongst them. . 5.
